name: metavr_app
description:
Query and manage apps on a connected Meta Quest VR headset via metavr (Meta's Quest dev CLI). DO NOT GUESS what's installed.

Read actions: list (target=<serial>, app_type=all|user|system, all optional), info (package=<package>).

Mutating actions: install (apk_path; replace / grant_permissions / downgrade optional), uninstall (package; keep_data optional — destructive), launch (package; activity optional), stop (package), clear (package — destructive), travel-test (package; destination=<api_name>; deeplink_message / lobby optional — launch at a travel/deeplink destination for multiplayer testing).

Call metavr_device action='list' first when multiple headsets may be connected so you can pass `target`.

action.description:
Action to run. One of:
- list: list installed apps (target=<serial> optional; app_type=<all|user|system> optional, default 'all')
- info: Android manifest, version, and signing info for an installed app (package=<package>)
- install: install an APK (apk_path=<path>; replace, grant_permissions, downgrade are optional bools)
- uninstall: uninstall an app (package=<package>; keep_data optional bool) — destructive
- launch: launch an app (package=<package>; activity optional)
- stop: force stop an app (package=<package>)
- clear: clear app data (package=<package>) — destructive
- travel-test: launch an app at a travel/deeplink destination for multiplayer testing (package=<package>; destination=<api_name>; deeplink_message optional; lobby optional)

activity.description: Activity to launch (e.g. .MainActivity). Optional; defaults to the package's launcher activity. Only used with action='launch'.

apk_path.description: Filesystem path to an APK on the developer's machine. Required for action='install'.

app_type.description: Filter for action='list': 'all', 'user' (third-party), or 'system'. Defaults to 'all'.

deeplink_message.description: Deeplink message payload. Optional; only used with action='travel-test'.

destination.description: Destination api name to travel to. Required for action='travel-test'.

downgrade.description: Allow version downgrade. Only used with action='install'.

grant_permissions.description: Grant all runtime permissions on install. Only used with action='install'.

keep_data.description: Keep app data and cache when uninstalling. Only used with action='uninstall'.

lobby.description: Lobby session id to join. Optional; only used with action='travel-test'.

package.description: Android package name (e.g. com.oculus.myapp). Required for info / uninstall / launch / stop / clear.

replace.description: Replace the existing installation (keep data). Only used with action='install'.

target.description: Device serial used to disambiguate when more than one device is connected. Optional; passed to metavr as the global `--device <serial>` flag.
